compactBelow.use: Below this width the app shows one pane at a time

iconsFrom.use: From this width the pipeline steps show their icons

stampFrom.use: From this stage width the title block is a boxed corner stamp

wideFrom.use: From this width the app shows three columns

shortHeight.use: At or below this height the chrome shrinks, as on a phone on its side

compactZoom.use: Drawing zoom on a compact window, so the drawing is readable
